content: Root cause: The bug was caused by incorrectly passing the address of the array `fn` to the function `roa_parent`. The original code used `&fn`, which resulted in a pointer to the array itself rather than a pointer to the first element of the array. This led to incorrect behavior when the function expected a pointer to a pointer to the first element. The fix involved creating a separate pointer `fnp` that correctly points to the first element of the array, allowing the function to operate as intended.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by incorrectly passing the address of the array `fn` to the function `roa_parent`. The original code used `&fn`, which resulted in a pointer to the array itself rather than a pointer to the first element of the array. This led to incorrect behavior when the function expected a pointer to a pointer to the first element. The fix involved creating a separate pointer `fnp` that correctly points to the first element of the array, allowing the function to operate as intended.
Patch:
From e50a68014d0f5206e5d69028eb2e83ebfefa985e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Richard Hansen <rhansen@bbn.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2016 03:04:40 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] fix getting pointer to pointer to start of array

According to the C standard, if foo is an array type, foo can also be
used as a pointer to the first element in the array in many contexts.
However, unlike an actual pointer, &foo does not get the address of
the address of the first element; it is the same as foo without the &.

This fixes a bug introduced in b9d846a.
---
 lib/rpki/tests/roa_test/roa_test.c | 3 ++-
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/lib/rpki/tests/roa_test/roa_test.c b/lib/rpki/tests/roa_test/roa_test.c
index 3f3d4fc7..fc45c0cd 100644
--- a/lib/rpki/tests/roa_test/roa_test.c
+++ b/lib/rpki/tests/roa_test/roa_test.c
@@ -90,6 +90,7 @@ int main(
     char *filename_cnf = NULL;
     char *ski;
     char fn[PATH_MAX];
+    char *fnp = &fn[0];
     int sta = 0;
 
     CMS(&roa, (ushort) 0);
@@ -148,7 +149,7 @@ int main(
         freescm(scmp);
         return -4;
     }
-    cert = (X509 *)roa_parent(scmp, conp, ski, &fn, &sta);
+    cert = (X509 *)roa_parent(scmp, conp, ski, &fnp, &sta);
     disconnectscm(conp);
     freescm(scmp);
     free(ski);
--
